fusions.name: Thousandth Repetition
fusions.desc: A tongue-lash at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It always strikes critically.

fusions.name: Opening Form
fusions.desc: Flicks your tongue at the first enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Motionless Focus
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds, and you regain 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Long Wait, Clean Cut
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
